definitions.semanticMeaning: An exact advisory record affirmatively applies to the exact selected package and version under the registered advisory query.
claimsMaySupport: The identified advisory with the controlled severity applies to the selected package version.
claimsMayNotSupport: No other advisory applies.
The repository has no repository-scoped advisory.
The recorded severity is the field-wide maximum unless pagination is closed.

definitions.semanticMeaning: The exact package version declares the controlled framework package as a peer dependency at the exact retained range.
claimsMaySupport: The package declares a peer relationship with the controlled framework package at the retained range.
claimsMayNotSupport: General framework compatibility beyond the declaration.
Runtime behavior, adapter completeness, or compatibility with every version in the range.
Absence of support for undeclared frameworks.

definitions.semanticMeaning: The exact published npm version exposes an explicit importable runtime entry point through exports, main, or module.
claimsMaySupport: An importable runtime package adoption surface is affirmatively published at the exact package version.
claimsMayNotSupport: The package is the only adoption form.
No external service is required.
The package alone supplies the requested capability.
The package establishes a specific in-process architecture.

definitions.semanticMeaning: The bounded repository release source contains the exact non-draft release tag, publication time, and prerelease state.
claimsMaySupport: The identified release was published with the retained prerelease state at the retained time.
claimsMayNotSupport: The identified release is the latest release unless the source set is closed.
No older or newer release exists outside an unclosed bounded window.

definitions.semanticMeaning: GitHub's exact-commit license classification supplies one recognized non-NOASSERTION SPDX identifier.
claimsMaySupport: The source recognizes the retained SPDX license identifier at the exact commit.
claimsMayNotSupport: A missing, null, or NOASSERTION value is a favorable license.
The detected identifier resolves every licensing exception or compatibility question.

definitions.semanticMeaning: GitHub's structured primary-language property maps through the accepted controlled primary-language mapping to one repository language/ecosystem fact.
claimsMaySupport: The repository's structured primary language maps to the retained controlled language/ecosystem at the snapshot cutoff.
claimsMayNotSupport: The retained value is the repository's complete language set.
The retained value proves consumer runtime compatibility.
npm publication proves this fact.

definitions.semanticMeaning: An exact verified root compose.json service declares build context dot, binding that service's container build to the candidate repository root at the exact commit.
claimsMaySupport: The repository publishes a self-build container service declaration at the exact commit.
claimsMayNotSupport: The declaration is production-suitable.
Every candidate capability is served by the service.
Compose is required.
No other deployment mode exists.
Generic external services are candidate deployment units.
